Partial offshore Portugal Current44–36N and20–12W reach within the Martins2002 statistical-box context. Exclude coastal Portugal Current,coastal countercurrent,slope undercurrents,Azores eastward jet and downstream Canary as target identities. Source mean/error statistics are not instantaneous speed bounds or depth uncertainty. A broad-gate southward maximum may be mesoscale circulation rather than a representative diffuse-current axis. No full current width,core identity or year-round continuity is established.

Partial northward eastern Irminger Sea branch along the western Reykjanes Ridge flank, 56–65 N editorial gates. Source describes two cores and intermediate return flow; one local integral maximum is not their summed transport, a uniquely tracked core or a whole-current section. Source also includes deeper northward IC water: a connected velocity contour does not separate upper mode water from deep water masses. Exclude return toward Greenland, North Icelandic continuation, interior gyre circuits, opposite ridge-side current and detached eddies as target identities; broad gates do not independently resolve them.

Partial northward West Spitsbergen slope-current corridor from 73 N editorial Barents-departure approach to 79.6 N pre-branching gate. Broad northward maxima do not independently resolve these branches or Atlantic Water membership. Source 1,000 m glider limit is not a current bottom; 20–500 m averaged velocities and source water-mass thresholds are not adopted as model layer boundaries. Spitsbergen Atlantic naming is not merged.

reference_interpolation: Bilinear upper/lower depths in longitude and sin(latitude),mean-radius6371008.8m sphere;exact common native longitude faces and unique conservative cross-section depth links only. All original source finite/censor/axis gates retained.
interpretation: Hypothetical partial regional reference volumes,not measured physical current water volumes. Sparse endpoint support does not establish interior ocean,terrain clearance,flow continuity,water-mass/current identity,whole-current extent or flow-normal geometry. Censored/missing/ambiguous bands remain unknown. Sampling brackets are interpolation-sensitivity scenarios,not physical uncertainty or annual ranges. Different date support masks are not comparable seasonal totals. No sums across currents,branches,dates or overlapping products.
